note: Launch batch for DentalPULSE Advanced Dental Probiotics: 30 statics in competitor/trending formats. Mix: 12 core bad breath, 6 mouth+gut, 6 tonsil stones/throat, 6 tests (GLP-1, aligners, gums, skeptic, after antibiotics, romance). 6 cartoon/illustrated, 3 native.

concepts.angle: Mouthwash dependence · format: 'Official Apology Statement' letter
concepts.based_on: Inspo pull: 'Official Apology Statement' letter ad (rising, 8d)
concepts.headline: OFFICIAL APOLOGY STATEMENT
concepts.prompt: A plain white page styled like a formal corporate apology letter, lots of white space, left-aligned. At the top in bold red caps: "OFFICIAL APOLOGY STATEMENT". Below in dark navy body text, short paragraphs: "To the mint, gum and mouthwash companies:" then "We owe you an apology." then "Since our customers started taking one DentalPULSE capsule a day, they buy a lot less of you." then "Fewer emergency mints. Fewer gum packs before meetings. Less mouthwash in the desk drawer." then "Unfortunately, this was intentional." then a handwritten-style signature "With love, DentalPULSE". In the lower right corner the DentalPULSE jar stands on the page with a soft shadow, about 30% of the canvas height.
